svg.title: Where the trading fee goes.
svg.desc: The 4 percent base trading revenue is divided into developer 1.27 percent, stock acquisition 0.51 percent, community 0.76 percent, protocol-owned liquidity 0.96 percent and staker ETH rewards 0.50 percent of the raw fee basis. Up to 0.50 percent additional opening or surge charge and separate LP fees may apply. No fixed APY is promised. Implementation snapshot 30 OCT 2026. Prelaunch: deployment and activation are not verified by this diagram. Sources: omerta-contracts/src/market-v2/core/OmertaPoolManagerV2.sol:546; omerta-contracts/src/market-v2/OmertaHookV2.sol:34; omerta-contracts/src/market-v2/OmertaEthRewardsV2.sol:32.

g.text: Base charge: 4% on buys and sells.
Opening / surge: up to 0.50% extra. LP fees are separate.
Actual funding comes first. No fixed APY.
